title: Isometric interaction review — synthetic responsiveness fixture
implementation: Production DrawingCanvas, HybridProjectionLayer, HybridViewportController, HVAC geometry and route-preview store

fixture.purpose: Interaction and rendering regression. Extra pipes are intentionally unconnected; visible VRF warnings are expected. This fixture is not a compliance-approved design.

environment.notes: Absolute frame rate and driver/shader initialization cost do not represent a hardware-accelerated user workstation.

baseline: Captured before pointer coalescing, cancellation/release-coordinate fixes, incremental preview-cache update and outline optimization. Stable combined preview memo was already present.
input: Real CDP mouse/key gestures for orbit, pan, wall and pipe drags; deterministic PointerEvent bursts, pointercancel, unrelated-pointer release and blur signals exercise event-handler edge cases.

checks.name: Pointer burst picks once per animation frame
Unrelated pointer up preserves owner; fresh drag commits once
Pipe handle commits valid edit once
No JavaScript or WebGL shader errors
Active route preview navigation retains meshes and model

limitations: Fresh-context first outline activation still produced a 695 ms postfx/shader/driver stall in the software renderer; warm median was 13 ms. This audit does not establish that every first-use GPU stall is eliminated.
Mesh-build timing instrumentation covers committed meshes in the old bundle and both committed/preview cache meshes in the new bundle; those raw counts are not compared directly.
Screenshot is a synthetic responsiveness fixture, not a construction or regulatory compliance deliverable.
